items.title: SD-075 phasic-warmup-rescue diagnostic (readiness probe for a future MECH-063(ii) retest)
items.note: NOT a V3-EXQ-779c. The obvious next step after V3-EXQ-779b (raise the step-budget cap and re-run) is REFUSED by the confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-779b_2026-07-19 re-derive brake (MECH-063 count=3, threshold=2): the root cause is the phasic surprise-EMA resetting every episode boundary (seed 23 averages 6.9 steps/episode against a ~10-tick EMA time constant), not insufficient env-step exposure -- 6 event ticks measured at BOTH 835 steps (779a) and 2400 steps (779b, 2.9x more exposure). The named upstream substrate (sd_phasic_ema_episode_continuity, SD-075) is now IMPLEMENTED (ree-v3 4a5139838b, 2026-07-19), but its own implementation note leaves an explicit open question: SD-075 live smoke found n_events_converged=0 in BOTH continuity modes for an UNTRAINED agent (every phasic event lands inside the convergence gate warmup window), and defers to a future run whether a TRAINED agent rescues it -- 'choosing is a retest-design decision', 'NO V3-EXQ-779c may be queued'. This experiment answers exactly that open question (warmup=0 control vs warmup=40 trained, holding SD-075 carry-continuity mode fixed) and only that question -- it is a diagnostic probe (CLAIM_IDS=[]), NOT a MECH-063/SD-069 claim test; neither PASS nor FAIL here is evidence for or against those claims. GOV-REUSE-1 check: this is a genuinely new manipulation (agent training x SD-075 carry mode) never previously run -- the scratch spike this formalizes (experiments/_scratch/sd075_warmup_rescue_spike.py, authored 2026-07-19) was never queued or run to completion; not recoverable from existing manifests. Re-derive brake (2.5b): checked for MECH-063 (fired, count=3, substrate now IMPLEMENTED -- see above) and SD-069 (0 prior substrate_ceiling autopsies, not braked); this script is diagnostic-purpose and does not itself constitute the braked retest. Substrate-path overlap gate (2.5c): two open corrupting entries (mode-governance-engagement, contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy) overlap this driver's agent.py / e1_deep.py imports at module level; both are out of this driver's causal path or bias conservative -- full reasoning in the script docstring SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP GATE section (same pattern as the 947/949 driver family). If this probe confirms rescue, a NEW-NUMBER MECH-063(ii) retest using carry mode + this warmup exposure is evidence-supported (still a governance call to actually queue it). If it does not, route to further /implement-substrate work on SD-075, not another lettered probe.
